llmConfig.actionDescription: Use this tool to route meeting action items into the right systems. Given a meeting summary and a list of action items (one per line), it classifies each item as: a content idea (creates a HubSpot content_piece record in Idea stage), a Linear task suggestion (engineering/dev work), or a HubSpot task suggestion (general follow-up). Use this after a meeting when the user says 'route these action items', 'process my meeting notes', 'create content ideas from this meeting', or provides a list of follow-ups. The meetingSummary provides context but is not required. The actionItems should be provided as a newline-separated list. Only content ideas are automatically created in HubSpot; Linear and HubSpot tasks are returned as suggestions for the user to create manually.

en.actionDescription: Classifies meeting action items and auto-creates HubSpot content_piece records for content ideas.

inputFieldDescriptions.meetingSummary: Brief summary of what the meeting was about. Used as context for new content record notes. Optional.
inputFieldDescriptions.actionItems: List of action items from the meeting, one per line. Bullet points and numbering are stripped automatically.
